Chapter 01 · The Land

North Bengal
grows the table.

Dinajpur sits in the north-west of Bangladesh, a region of wide paddy plains where rice, mustard and spices are part of the farming year. Uttorbongo starts from that landscape and asks a simple question: how do these ingredients reach a modern kitchen well?

মাটির কাছাকাছি, মানুষের কাছাকাছি।

Chapter 04 · Food, Memory and Culture

The smell of a
weekday kitchen.

ভাত, ডাল, সরিষার তেলের ঘ্রাণ — এভাবেই বাড়ির কথা মনে পড়ে।

Everyday cooking in Bengal runs on a few ingredients used with care: fragrant rice, turmeric, chilli and pungent mustard oil. A brand that sells them should respect that.
